parsed.post: Successful experiment! Reducing TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE from 524288 to 262144 improved val_bpb from 1.016710 to 1.001203, likely due to more optimizer steps within the 5-minute budget. Next, I'll explore increasing DEPTH to 8 to see if higher capacity can further drive down loss.
parsed.description: Increasing DEPTH from 6 to 8 to increase model capacity while maintaining the optimized batch size and learning rate settings.
